skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to clean and prepare data for analysis.
Understanding and application of various data mining techniques.
Identifying patterns within large datasets using advanced methods.
Performing cluster analysis on datasets to identify groupings.
Using classification algorithms to categorize data.
Proficiency in using Business Intelligence tools such as Microsoft SQL Server.
Proficiency in programming languages such as R and Python.
Analyzing complex problems and making informed decisions based on data.
Developing solutions to complex data-related issues.
